    Comprehensive Platform for Electronic Circuits & Systems
    Design Verification
    Early in the Design Process

    BQR helps electronic design and system engineering teams eliminate hidden design flaws, reduce costly maintenance, and ensure products work right the first time. By combining AI, simulation, and Shift‑Left verification, BQR empowers you to design reliable, maintainable, and safe systems: faster and smarter.

    Contact Us
    Explore Our solutions

    With over 35 years of experience in electronic design reliability and system RAMS, BQR has consistently demonstrated that the most effective time to improve MTBF, availability and lifecycle cost is during the design phase; well before the product is built and installed

    Bridge The Gap

    Over 70% of field failures originate during the design stage, yet traditional DRC tools  and generic ECAD checks miss most of them. BQR’s intelligent verification technology identifies electrical stress, derating issues, and schematic design errors early, preventing redesigns and production failures.

    Contact us for the full report

    System Engineering & RAMS

    RAMS analyses are a core element of systems engineering, ensuring compliance with both regulatory standards and customer requirements. Delays in delivering these analyses can lead to contractual penalties and slip key project milestones.

    Read the Case Study

    BQR solution:

    • Streamline System Level RAMS analyses with dedicated software: MTBF, FMEA / FMECA,
      RBD, FTA and apmOptimizer

    • Integrate data in a central RAMS database

    • Comply with RAMS standards

    • Data is ready for reuse in future projects

    Hardware Maintenance Improvement

    Maintenance shouldn’t be an afterthought. Poor early planning can inflate lifecycle costs by 20–40% and reduce availability by up to 15%. BQR’s maintenance planning and optimization tools enable smarter planning from day one.

    Contact us for the full report

    BQR solution:

    • Achieve up to 25–40% lifecycle cost reduction through optimized maintenance plans and spare parts strategies

    • 30–50 % less downtime

    • •Improve system availability by 10–20% with optimized preventive and corrective actions

    • Shorten the design cycle & Save time and Money

    • Design Right, Maintain Smarter

    Hardware Design Improvement

    BQR solution:

    • Eliminate up to 70% of field failures such as electrical-overstress (EOS) and No-Failures-Found

    • Real-time electrical - engineering assistance in component specification and derating decisions directly inside your ECAD tool

    • Shorten the design cycle & Save time and Money

    • Capture design knowledge and test data for AI tools and digital-twin RAMS models

    • Shift left, detect design errors early

    Our Products Suite

    BQR delivers a comprehensive set of ECAD extensions and system‑engineering tools that bring reliability, maintainability, and performance analysis
    directly into your design process.

    Electronics

    Synthelyzer®

    Smart ECAD Plug-In

    Automatically detect schematic issues, perform component derating, and predict MTBF directly in Altium, OrCAD, or Siemens Xpedition. Get real‑time design feedback powered by AI.

    Learn More
    Buy

    fiXtress®

    System Level Reliability & Thermal Analysis

    Integrate multiple PCB designs, calculate system‑level MTBF, and estimate thermal stress. fiXtress visualizes MTBF vs. temperature vs. environment for smarter design decisions.

    Learn More
    Buy

    CircuitHawk®

    AI-Powered Circuit Simulation

    Find hidden design errors before production. Circuit‑Hawk performs automated schematic analysis, stress simulation, and overstress detection across single or multi‑board systems.

    Learn More
    Buy

    RAMS for Systems

    CARE® 

    System Computer Aided Reliability
    & Safety Engineering

    CARE integrates FMEA and FMECA, fault tree Analysis (FTA), Reliability Block Diagrams (RBD), and diagnostics to identify design risks early. Ideal for aerospace, defense, rail, automotive, energy and medical systems requiring high reliability and safety.

    Learn More
    Buy

    apmOptimizer®

    Maintenance
    Planning & Optimization 

    apmOptimizer is maintenance planning and optimization software for fleets and complex assets. Use RAMS and MSG-3-based analysis to reduce downtime, extend asset life, and control spare parts and logistics support cost with simulation-based optimization and logistics support analysis (LSA)
